name: CRETI homepage: real estate technology research organisation
title: CRETI homepage: real estate technology research organisation
answer: This is the landing page of CRETI, the Center for Real Estate Technology & Innovation, a research and education organisation focused on real estate technology and adjacent sectors. The most useful thing it states is that CRETI does not invest or advise on investments in funds or technology companies. The page itself carries no funding data, no proptech capital figures and no AI-specific findings, so it is a thin source for investment tracking.

sections.body: CRETI, the Center for Real Estate Technology & Innovation, publishes this page. It is a research and education organisation, according to the text, dedicated to the health and wellness of real estate technology and adjacent sectors. The harvested text is a short landing page rather than a report or dataset. It includes a disclaimer that the information is for general information and entertainment purposes only, and a statement that CRETI does not invest or advise in the investment of funds or technology companies. No publication date is given in the supplied text; the harvest date is 2026-09-27.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The supplied text presents CRETI as a research and education organisation dedicated to the health and wellness of real estate technology and adjacent sectors. That mission statement appears twice. The page also carries a disclaimer saying the information provided is for general information and entertainment purposes only, that all information is provided in good faith, and that CRETI makes no representation or warranty of any kind regarding the accuracy, validity, reliability, or completeness of any information on the site. A further statement says CRETI does not invest or advise in the investment of funds or technology companies. Beyond those points, the text contains no funding data, no proptech capital tracking, no AI startup figures, no investment barometer, no methodology, no report titles, no dates and no datasets. It is a short landing page with mission and legal language rather than a substantive research publication. The disclaimer limits reliance on anything on the site. The text does not describe CRETI's audience, funding model or research outputs.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The text gives no numbers. Its specific claims are that CRETI is a research and education organisation dedicated to the health and wellness of real estate technology and adjacent sectors, that its information is for general information and entertainment purposes only, that it makes no representation or warranty regarding accuracy, validity, reliability or completeness, and that CRETI does not invest or advise in the investment of funds or technology companies.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in real estate would not find funding data, AI startup counts or proptech capital figures on this page. The source is useful mainly to identify CRETI and its stated role, and to note its explicit position that it does not invest or advise. The industry page claim that CRETI tracks proptech capital is not supported by the supplied text. Anyone seeking the sector's investment barometer would need a different CRETI document or dataset, because this landing page does not contain one.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Real Estate

sections.body: The supplied text is a short landing page with little substance. It does not cover funding trends, AI adoption, startup lists, market size, dates or methodology. It is organisational and legal copy rather than research. The disclaimer says information is for general information and entertainment purposes only and makes no warranty about accuracy, validity, reliability or completeness. CRETI states it does not invest or advise, so the page is not investment advice. No publication date is stated, and the harvest date is 2026-09-27.
